section_title: Defining Linear Equations and Their General Form
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-7.6s) - Introduction
title = Text("Linear Equations in Two Variables", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Definition & General Form", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(2.6)

# Segment 2 (7.6-18.3s) - Definition of pair of equations
definition = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\text{A pair of linear equations:}"),
    MathTex(r"\bullet \text{ Two equations of degree one}"),
    MathTex(r"\bullet \text{ Same two variables (x and y)}") 
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).shift(UP)

self.play(Write(definition[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(
    FadeIn(definition[1], shift=RIGHT),
    FadeIn(definition[2], shift=RIGHT),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 3 (18.3-37.1s) - Examples and general form
example_eqns = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"2x + 3y = 7"),
    MathTex(r"x - y = 1")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).shift(LEFT * 3)

general_form = MathTex(r"ax + by + c = 0").shift(RIGHT * 3)
general_box = SurroundingRectangle(general_form, color=YELLOW)

self.play(
    Write(example_eqns[0]),
    Write(example_eqns[1]),
    run_time=6
)
self.play(Write(general_form), run_time=4)
self.play(Create(general_box), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.8)

# Segment 4 (37.1-51.3s) - Coefficient conditions
conditions = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"a, b, c \in \mathbb{R}"),
    MathTex(r"a \text{ and } b \text{ cannot both be zero}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(general_form, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(conditions[0]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(conditions[1]), run_time=3)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 5 (51.3-80.2s) - Need for two equations
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-5, 5],
    y_range=[-5, 5],
    axis_config={"include_tip": True}
).scale(0.6).shift(DOWN)

line1 = axes.plot(lambda x: (7-2*x)/3, color=BLUE)
line2 = axes.plot(lambda x: x-1, color=RED)
intersection_point = Dot(axes.c2p(2, 1), color=YELLOW)

self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(definition, example_eqns, general_form, general_box, conditions)),
    Create(axes),
    run_time=4
)
self.play(Create(line1), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(line2), run_time=3)

intersection_label = Text("Unique Solution", font_size=24).next_to(intersection_point, RIGHT)
self.play(
    Create(intersection_point),
    Write(intersection_label),
    run_time=3
)

infinite_solutions = Text("Each line has infinite solutions", font_size=28).to_edge(UP)
unique_solution = Text("Intersection gives unique solution", font_size=28).next_to(infinite_solutions, DOWN)

self.play(Write(infinite_solutions), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(unique_solution), run_time=3)
self.wait(9.9)

section_title: Graphical Solutions: Intersecting, Parallel, and Coincident Lines
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-19.3s) - Introduction
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-5, 5], 
    y_range=[-5, 5],
    tips=True,
    axis_config={"include_numbers": True}
)
title = Text("Graphical Solutions of Linear Systems", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Three Types of Solutions", font_size=28).next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Create(axes), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(12.3)

# Segment 2 (19.3-41.6s) - Intersecting Lines
line1 = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.5*x + 1, color=BLUE)
line2 = axes.plot(lambda x: -x + 3, color=RED)
intersect_point = Dot(axes.c2p(1.33, 1.67), color=YELLOW)
intersect_label = Text("Unique Solution", font_size=24).next_to(intersect_point, UR)

self.play(Create(line1), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(line2), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Create(intersect_point),
    Write(intersect_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(14.3)

# Segment 3 (41.6-62.4s) - Parallel Lines
self.play(
    FadeOut(line1), 
    FadeOut(line2),
    FadeOut(intersect_point),
    FadeOut(intersect_label),
    run_time=2
)

parallel1 = axes.plot(lambda x: 2*x - 1, color=BLUE)
parallel2 = axes.plot(lambda x: 2*x + 1, color=RED)
no_solution = Text("No Solution", font_size=24).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(Create(parallel1), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(parallel2), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(no_solution), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.8)

# Segment 4 (62.4-83.8s) - Coincident Lines
self.play(
    FadeOut(parallel1),
    FadeOut(parallel2),
    FadeOut(no_solution),
    run_time=2
)

coincident = axes.plot(lambda x: -0.5*x + 2, color=GREEN)
coincident_copy = axes.plot(lambda x: -0.5*x + 2, color=YELLOW)
infinite_label = Text("Infinite Solutions", font_size=24).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(Create(coincident), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(coincident_copy), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(infinite_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(11.3)

# Segment 5 (83.8-92.4s) - Summary
summary_text = Text(
    "Three Cases:\n• Intersecting (One Solution)\n• Parallel (No Solution)\n• Coincident (Infinite Solutions)",
    font_size=24
).to_edge(LEFT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(coincident),
    FadeOut(coincident_copy),
    FadeOut(infinite_label),
    Write(summary_text),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.6)

# Segment 1 (0-15.2s) - Introduction to algebraic methods
title = Text("Algebraic Methods for Linear Equations", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Substitution & Elimination", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)

eq1 = MathTex("2x + y = 8").shift(UP * 2)
eq2 = MathTex("x - y = 2").next_to(eq1, DOWN, buff=0.5)
box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(eq1, eq2), buff=0.3, color=BLUE)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(eq1), Write(eq2), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(box), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.2)

# Segment 2 (15.2-26.9s) - Substitution method
sub_title = Text("Substitution Method", color=YELLOW, font_size=36).next_to(subtitle, DOWN, buff=1)
step1 = MathTex("y = 8 - 2x").shift(LEFT * 3)
step2 = MathTex("x - (8-2x) = 2").next_to(step1, RIGHT, buff=2)
arrow1 = Arrow(step1.get_right(), step2.get_left(), color=WHITE)

self.play(FadeIn(sub_title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(step1), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(arrow1), Write(step2), run_time=2)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 3 (26.9-38.6s) - Transition to elimination
step3 = MathTex("3x = 10").next_to(step2, RIGHT, buff=2)
arrow2 = Arrow(step2.get_right(), step3.get_left(), color=WHITE)
final_x = MathTex("x = \frac{10}{3}").next_to(step3, DOWN)

self.play(Create(arrow2), Write(step3), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(final_x), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(step1, step2, step3, arrow1, arrow2)), run_time=2)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 4 (38.6-56.9s) - Elimination method
elim_title = Text("Elimination Method", color=GREEN, font_size=36).move_to(sub_title)
eq3 = MathTex("2x + y = 8").shift(UP * 0.5)
eq4 = MathTex("x - y = 2").next_to(eq3, DOWN, buff=0.5)
arrow3 = Arrow(start=LEFT * 3, end=RIGHT * 3, color=YELLOW).next_to(eq4, DOWN)
result = MathTex("3x = 10").next_to(arrow3, DOWN)

self.play(ReplacementTransform(sub_title, elim_title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(eq3), Write(eq4), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(arrow3), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(result), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.3)

# Segment 5 (56.9-73.1s) - Comparison
compare_box = VGroup(
    Text("When to Use:", font_size=32),
    Text("• Substitution: One variable easily isolated", font_size=28),
    Text("• Elimination: Similar coefficients", font_size=28)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).shift(DOWN)

self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(eq3, eq4, arrow3, result)), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(compare_box), run_time=3)
self.wait(11.2)

section_title: Predicting Solution Types Using Coefficient Ratios
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-16.8s) - Introduction
title = Text("Predicting Solution Types\nUsing Coefficient Ratios", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("A geometric approach to linear systems", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(11.8)

# Segment 2 (16.8-40.1s) - General form equations
eq1 = MathTex(r"a_1x + b_1y + c_1 = 0").shift(UP)
eq2 = MathTex(r"a_2x + b_2y + c_2 = 0").next_to(eq1, DOWN)
eq_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(eq1, eq2), buff=0.3)
eq_label = Text("General Form", font_size=32).next_to(eq_box, UP)

self.play(FadeOut(subtitle), run_time=1)
self.play(Write(eq1), Write(eq2), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(eq_box), Write(eq_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(17.4)

# Segment 3 (40.1-64.0s) - Unique solution case
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-5, 5], y_range=[-5, 5],
    axis_config={"include_tip": True}
).scale(0.7).to_edge(RIGHT)

line1 = axes.plot(lambda x: 2*x + 1, color=BLUE)
line2 = axes.plot(lambda x: -x + 3, color=RED)

ratio_text = MathTex(r"\frac{a_1}{a_2} \neq \frac{b_1}{b_2}").to_edge(LEFT)
unique_label = Text("Unique Solution", font_size=32).next_to(ratio_text, DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(eq_box), FadeOut(eq_label),
    eq1.animate.to_edge(LEFT+UP),
    eq2.animate.to_edge(LEFT+UP).shift(DOWN*0.7),
    Create(axes),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Create(line1), Create(line2), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(ratio_text), Write(unique_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(15.9)

# Segment 4 (64.0-91.4s) - Parallel lines case
parallel_ratio = MathTex(
    r"\frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} \neq \frac{c_1}{c_2}"
).to_edge(LEFT)
parallel_label = Text("No Solution\n(Parallel Lines)", font_size=32).next_to(parallel_ratio, DOWN)

line3 = axes.plot(lambda x: 2*x + 1, color=BLUE)
line4 = axes.plot(lambda x: 2*x - 2, color=RED)

self.play(
    FadeOut(line1), FadeOut(line2),
    FadeOut(ratio_text), FadeOut(unique_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Create(line3), Create(line4), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(parallel_ratio), Write(parallel_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(20.4)

# Segment 5 (91.4-125.9s) - Coincident lines case
coincident_ratio = MathTex(
    r"\frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{c_1}{c_2}"
).to_edge(LEFT)
coincident_label = Text("Infinitely Many Solutions\n(Coincident Lines)", font_size=32).next_to(coincident_ratio, DOWN)

line5 = axes.plot(lambda x: 2*x + 1, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=8)

self.play(
    FadeOut(line3), FadeOut(line4),
    FadeOut(parallel_ratio), FadeOut(parallel_label),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Create(line5), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(coincident_ratio), Write(coincident_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(27.5)

section_title: Case Study: Solving a Real-World Word Problem
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-16.8s) - Introducing word problem
title = Text("Word Problem", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
problem_text = VGroup(
    Text("Two numbers have a sum of 10", font_size=32),
    Text("Their difference is 2", font_size=32)
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(problem_text[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(problem_text[1]), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.8)

# Segment 2 (16.8-27.4s) - Defining variables
variables = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\text{Let }x\text{ be the first number}"),
    MathTex(r"\text{Let }y\text{ be the second number}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(problem_text, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(
    Write(variables[0]),
    Write(variables[1]),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(6.7)

# Segment 3 (27.4-41.6s) - First equation
eq1 = MathTex(r"x + y = 10").scale(1.5)
eq1.next_to(variables, DOWN, buff=1)
eq1_box = SurroundingRectangle(eq1, color=BLUE)

self.play(Write(eq1), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(eq1_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(9.2)

# Segment 4 (41.6-59.4s) - Second equation and system
eq2 = MathTex(r"x - y = 2").scale(1.5)
eq2.next_to(eq1, DOWN, buff=0.5)
eq2_box = SurroundingRectangle(eq2, color=GREEN)
system = VGroup(eq1.copy(), eq2).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5)
system_box = SurroundingRectangle(system, color=YELLOW)

self.play(Write(eq2), run_time=3)
self.play(Create(eq2_box), run_time=2)
self.play(
    FadeOut(eq1_box),
    FadeOut(eq2_box),
    Transform(eq1, system[0]),
    Transform(eq2, system[1]),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Create(system_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.8)

# Segment 5 (59.4-97.5s) - Solution process
solution_steps = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"(x + y) + (x - y) = 10 + 2"),
    MathTex(r"2x = 12"),
    MathTex(r"x = 6"),
    MathTex(r"6 + y = 10"),
    MathTex(r"y = 4")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(system_box, DOWN, buff=1)

final_answer = Text("The two numbers are 6 and 4", font_size=36)
final_answer.next_to(solution_steps, DOWN, buff=1)

# Show solution steps one by one
self.play(Write(solution_steps[0]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(solution_steps[1]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(solution_steps[2]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(solution_steps[3]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(solution_steps[4]), run_time=3)

# Show final answer
self.play(Write(final_answer), run_time=3)
self.wait(20.1)  # Remaining time to complete 38.1s segment
